opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.lead: Cells ranked by MOS, the market opportunity score. Every score carries its grade and says how much of the weight is covered by data.
opportunities.methodNote: Method {method}. Each component is a percentile among the cells that have it: a cell can rank high in a weak field. Pressure enters reversed, so less pressure is worth more points.
opportunities.summary: {ranked, plural, one {# cell ranked} other {# cells ranked}}, {insufficient} without a score
opportunities.noRanked: None of the cells shown has a MOS.

empty.title: MOS is not computed yet
empty.body: No cell has a score yet. The ranking appears after the first computation: until then we show no numbers.

whatIf.note: Scores recomputed here, in the browser, with your weights on the same percentiles. They are not saved and do not change the data.

weights.title: Weights
weights.lead: Move the weights to see how the ranking changes. Only the proportions matter: they always sum to 100%.
weights.allZero: Give at least one component a weight: with every weight at zero there is no ranking.
weights.fitNote: Fit needs a product passport. No cell has it today, so its weight only lowers coverage.
weights.name: Name of the set
weights.viewer: Your role can try weights, but not save them.

error.name: Give the set a name, 80 characters at most.
error.forbidden: Your role cannot save weight sets.
error.failed: We could not save. Try again shortly.

insufficient.title: Insufficient data
insufficient.lead: These cells have no MOS. They are not ranked and they do not count as zero.
insufficient.weights: No score with these weights: all the weight is on components without data.
